items.name: F1_charmer_hype
items.text: High-energy stereotypical snake-charmer 'ancient Egypt' music: a nasal, buzzy mizmar / zurna / pungi reed melody that leans hard on the Hijaz scale's signature step (D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat, C) with sinuous ornaments and trills, belly-dance darbuka doum-tek groove loud in the mix, finger cymbals (zills), tambourine, oud strumming, 128 BPM, punchy and driving, extra darbuka fills and claps, sly and catchy, made for a fast hook. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: F2_charmer_mystery
items.text: Slow, hypnotic and mysterious stereotypical snake-charmer 'ancient Egypt' music: a nasal, buzzy mizmar / zurna / pungi reed melody that leans hard on the Hijaz scale's signature step (D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat, C) with sinuous ornaments and trills, belly-dance darbuka doum-tek groove loud in the mix, finger cymbals (zills), tambourine, oud strumming, 90 BPM, a low drone under the reed melody like a cobra rising from a basket, sparse darbuka, shimmering finger cymbals, dark and enticing. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: F3_charmer_epic
items.text: Cinematic stereotypical snake-charmer 'ancient Egypt' music: a nasal, buzzy mizmar / zurna / pungi reed melody that leans hard on the Hijaz scale's signature step (D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat, C) with sinuous ornaments and trills, belly-dance darbuka doum-tek groove loud in the mix, finger cymbals (zills), tambourine, oud strumming, 110 BPM, with huge cinematic drums, low strings and big hits under the snake-charmer reed lead; majestic pharaohs and gods, still unmistakably the snake-charmer sound. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: F4_charmer_classic
items.text: In the style of the old public-domain 1890s 'snake charmer' tune everyone knows from cartoons: stereotypical snake-charmer 'ancient Egypt' music: a nasal, buzzy mizmar / zurna / pungi reed melody that leans hard on the Hijaz scale's signature step (D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat, C) with sinuous ornaments and trills, belly-dance darbuka doum-tek groove loud in the mix, finger cymbals (zills), tambourine, oud strumming, 115 BPM, the simple sinuous rising-and-falling snake-charmer motif repeated and varied, playful and iconic. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: F5_charmer_full60
items.text: A 60-second film score bed of stereotypical snake-charmer 'ancient Egypt' music: a nasal, buzzy mizmar / zurna / pungi reed melody that leans hard on the Hijaz scale's signature step (D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat, C) with sinuous ornaments and trills, belly-dance darbuka doum-tek groove loud in the mix, finger cymbals (zills), tambourine, oud strumming. 0-8 s: solo reed melody over a drone. 8-30 s: the full belly-dance groove at 115 BPM with the reed lead. 30-38 s: a break, drums drop out, only the drone, finger cymbals and a quiet reed phrase. 38-60 s: the biggest section, all drums back with frame-drum hits and cinematic low strings, the reed melody soaring. Instrumental, no vocals.
